name: esophageal dysphagia overview
title: Esophageal dysphagia decision chart: solids only points to a mechanical cause (ring, web or stricture, eosinophilic esophagitis, cancer), solids and liquids to a motility disorder (achalasia, distal esophageal spasm or jackhammer, scleroderma esophagus); each column gives presentation, numbered investigations and treatment

root.title: Food sticks SECONDS after the swallow, behind the sternum: SOLIDS only, or SOLIDS + LIQUIDS?
lines: can't START the swallow, coughing, choking, nasal regurgitation → OROPHARYNGEAL, not this chart
ask: where it sticks · progressive or intermittent · heartburn · weight loss, hematemesis, anemia

groups.title: SOLIDS only: MECHANICAL
lines: • endoscopy: sees the tissue + biopsy (invasive, perforation risk)
• barium swallow: easy, shows function, not tissue

groups.title: SOLIDS + LIQUIDS: MOTILITY
lines: esophageal MANOMETRY decides · endoscopy helps little

head: h
Ring, web or benign stricture
peptic (GERD) stricture most common
pres: • Schatzki ring: distal, FULL circle, INTERMITTENT
• web + iron deficiency anemia, glossitis, cheilosis = Plummer-Vinson
tx: proton pump inhibitor (PPI) or H2 blocker

head: h
Eosinophilic esophagitis
chronic ALLERGIC condition
eosinophils in the esophagus
inv: • > 15 eosinophils per high-power field, mid esophagus

head: h
Esophageal cancer
adenocarcinoma: DISTAL
squamous cell: proximal
pres: • adenocarcinoma: long GERD, BARRETT'S, obesity, smoking, men
• squamous: SMOKING, ALCOHOL, caustic injury, very hot drinks
tx: See the LUMINAL GI MALIGNANCIES lecture

head: h
Achalasia
lower esophageal sphincter (LES) FAILS TO RELAX
+ impaired peristalsis
